I spend the funded round, re-review once, and stop when the result is still issue-bearing. The wave is in-place integrated repair, so every step runs in `/workspace/project`, with no nested worktree and no patch replacement.

## 1. Record the spend before dispatch

```
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```

Tracker: task 3 stays `in_progress` and the phase stays `implement`.

## 2. Funded fix: one-step in-place implementer

The payload carries the prior CR report path under the re-review marker. Its tree-before is the tree recorded at the last CR dispatch (`wave <w> review 4 tree <sha-before>`).

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer", model: "<configured-impl-model>",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3-funded1.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Work from: /workspace/project (branch checkout, in place, no worktree); SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"].\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-cr4.md\nRead the saved report yourself and repair its findings. Do not commit or stage. pi-cohort saves your final report to the output path; do not write that file yourself." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] } }]
})
```

Observed: `wave <w> task 3 status DONE report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3-funded1.md patch none (in-place)`

## 3. Scoped gate, stage, record review tree

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs) >"<REPORT_DIR>/gate-0.log" 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
git -C /workspace/project add -A
```

Observed: exit 0.

Next I run the `fix-delta-tree-shell` block once, in full, with `FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'`. It prints `<sha-after>`.

```
wave <w> review 5 tree <sha-after>
```

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat <sha-before> <sha-after>
```

Observed: a nonempty tracked delta, so re-review proceeds.

## 4. CR re-review: one-step carrier

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "code-reviewer",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-cr5.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: CODE_VERDICT_SCHEMA,
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchors: [\"### Task 3:\"]; Spec: <absolute home spec>; BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>; HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"].\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-cr4.md\n<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md>\n## Fix delta\ntree-before: <sha-before>\ntree-after: <sha-after>\nProduce the delta yourself: git -C \"/workspace/project\" diff --binary <sha-before> <sha-after>" }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/verdict", in: ["FIX_FIRST", "REJECT"] } }]
})
```

Observed: `wave <w> task 3 verdict FIX_FIRST report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-cr5.md patch none (in-place)`, with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)`.

The review is issue-bearing and no funded round is left. `behaviourChange` routing is moot because no fix may be dispatched, so I escalate. There is no wave commit and task 3 stays `in_progress`.

## 5. Delegate stop-note wording

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "worker",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-stopnote.md", outputMode: "file-only",

Read the findings yourself; quote only residual issues; apply funded-round budget placement from reference/fix-loop.md and Implementer-failure stops. Return the exact one-screen note as answer." }

```

I consume only `answer` and print it verbatim. The turn ends after the note: the phase stays `implement`, task 3 stays `in_progress`, and no further tasks start.
